company.name: Lendflow
company.shortDescription: Lendflow is a fintech platform that enables lending, connecting businesses to lenders with tools for loan, credit decision, and automation.
company.description: Lendflow develops a lending infrastructure platform built to change and improve the way businesses access capital. They allow a user to embed financial products into their software to increase engagement, improve retention, and become a source of capital for their business users. They also provide term loans, lines of credit, and invoice factoring to cover businesses of all sizes and credit risks, enabling construction, home services companies, e-commerce, restaurants, transportation, and fitness businesses to connect their users with capital and increase the reach of their businesses.
